headline: Petroleum engineer specializing in artificial lift optimization with 8+ years at Saudi Aramco, combining traditional engineering expertise with advanced AI/machine learning capabilities. Pioneer in applying data science to electrical submersible pump (ESP) operations, with proven track record in digital transformation, automation, and predictive analytics. Bridge between field engineering and data science—translating operational challenges into ML solutions. Led deployment of AI-driven tools impacting thousands of wells. Patent holder and published researcher in petroleum engineering innovation. Session chair and speaker at major industry conferences (MEALC, IPTC). Currently pursuing Masters in Data Science (UC Berkeley) while driving digital transformation initiatives in Aramco's Northern Area production operations.
